text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Nakayama-san! Um... 
would it be alright if I opened it right 
away?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Do as you like. What's inside is pure 
Schrödinger until you open it. Which 
means—c'mon Buena, test your luck!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I knew it, I knew it, I knew it! 
It's a present from Nakayama, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's seriously insane! They had freakish 
handmade ghost photos in it! And huge 
dolls popping out!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There might be something in it! Or nothing 
at all! Seriously! So don't open it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't rain on my parade, Jordan. I'm 
not gonna give a boring gift on someone's 
birthday.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Enshrined within is a gift into which I 
have poured every ounce of my sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"You're... right! I'll open it right away, 
then."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Aah—I didn't send you anything "boring", 
after all... Heh heh!
